faq: Does my data train public AI models?
We choose providers and settings that do not use your content to train public models where this is offered, and tell you which settings we used. You can review the terms of any provider yourself.
What file types can you use?
PDF, Word, Google Docs, web pages, spreadsheets and plain text. Scanned documents need reading first, which we can include if you ask.
How often does it learn new content?
On a schedule or when you add a file, depending on the package. New content is checked before it goes live, so one wrong file does not change every answer.
Can I remove something it learned?
Yes. Delete the file or entry from the source and it stops being used once the content refreshes. We show you how to do that in the handover notes.
